Verbatim Windows failures (run 44681457334, JUnit; moved out of the plan to keep it under the review size limit):
- test_write_lock_busy_probe_7084::test_probe_answers_a_lock_held_by_another_process: `assert 'pid_state=not-running' in 'host=name-runnervmm7ud1 pid=7812 held=0s pid_state=unverified-live (start unknown)'`
- test_lock_timeout_names_holder_7084::test_contended_timeout_names_the_holder: `assert 'pid=7556' in 'flock: could not acquire lock after 1s (holder: host=name-runnervmm7ud1 pid=7536 held=1s pid_state=unverified-live (start unknown))'`
- test_mcp_idle_sync::test_a_busy_write_lock_is_logged_with_its_holder: `assert 'pid=9012' in '... (holder: host=name-runnervmm7ud1 pid=8428 held=1s pid_state=unverified-live (start unknown)) ...'`
- test_lock_stale_reclaim::test_acquire_reclaims_dead_owner_mkdir_lock: `LockTimeout: flock: could not acquire lock after 2s (holder: unknown (unrecognised ownership stamp))` (the `["true"]` dead-pid helper)
- test_stamped_lock (2): `a provably-orphaned lock must be reclaimed, not respected / assert None is not None` and `assert False` on the reclaim warning
- test_doctor_locks (6), test_atomic_ticket_dir_create_021d (1), test_stale_lock_reclaim_write (1): `worker 'gwN' crashed while running ...` (the `while _pid_alive(pid)` dead-pid search never ends)
Review run 2 (BLOCK): `_sweep_exited` raises AttributeError on Windows (os.WNOHANG is Unix-only), so the plan now adds the reap guard in compact_trigger.py plus tests; staging._is_abandoned is named as a consumer.
